scoring: Pivots and six-headings use gentle steering, 100 Hz control, 1 kHz physics and 10 ms leg-command delay. Moving trials use 0.25 m/s requested forward speed. Each change requires true body yaw within ±5° continuously for 1 s. Hold times exclude the initial straight setup. Foot force is the normal touch sensor in the original runner's steady walk or post-2 s steering window. Each 10 ms value is the largest average of 10 consecutive samples on that foot.
